title: Completed lisse sheaves and normalized finite etale systems
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be a Noetherian separated scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. A lisse $B_X$-module (respectively $E_X$-module) means a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] pro-etale locally finite free over that coefficient sheaf, allowing rank zero and varying finite local ranks.

Reduction $N\mapsto(N/\varpi^nN)_{n\geq1}$ is an equivalence from lisse $B_X$-modules to the category of normalized inverse systems of finite locally free $A/\varpi^n$-module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], with locally constant finite rank: transition maps induce $N_{n+1}\otimes_{A/\varpi^{n+1}}A/\varpi^n\cong N_n$. The inverse is $\varprojlim_n\nu_X^*N_n$, where $\nu_X^*$ is the etale-to-pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The functor from the raw $A$-linear localization of this lisse integral category to lisse $E_X$-modules, $N\mapsto N[1/\varpi]$, is fully faithful.

The reduction and inverse-limit equivalences, and this fully faithful rational realization, commute with module pullback on lisse objects and with finite coefficient extension. Their comparisons are the ones induced by the finite-level module pullbacks and scalar-extension maps, and satisfy the identity and composition equations.

proof.text: Obtain the integral continuous reduction datum and the residue-normalized coefficient isomorphism. Apply the pointwise comparison at every allowed base, and choose the resulting family inside this existence proof.
Apply the normalized tensor-operation construction to that family. Retain its integral and rational identity/composition maps and their four adjunction-unit normalizations.

Precomposition by each integral equivalence is fully faithful on functor categories. Lift the conjugated integral tensor identity/composition isomorphisms, obtaining the etale maps and precisely the two reduction equations. Postcomposition by each fully faithful rational realization similarly lifts the rational tensor maps to raw maps and gives the realization equations. These are the proved private lift/descend lemmas in the item.

For reconstruction, apply the target equivalence and postcompose with its invertible counit. The mate equation reduces identity to reduction_id using counit and etaleId naturality. For composition, use counit naturality, the second reduction naturality across the first reconstruction, and reduction_comp. Cancel the counit and use faithfulness. Assemble all System fields without a remaining hole in the item.
